description: This Java class 'XYData' manages a collection of 3D points grouped by X-values, providing methods for adding, setting, retrieving, and saving data points. It appears to be part of a telemetry or data logging system, given its use of 'FileLog' and methods for data range calculations.

classes.name: XYData
classes.description: Main class for storing and manipulating XY coordinate data with associated Y-axis values.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the Z value for the given X and Y coordinates by finding the relevant YAxisData.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a data point identified by RPM (used as X), a key (Y), and a value (Z).

methods.name: setPoint
methods.description: Sets the value for a specific 3D point.

methods.name: getYdata
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the YAxisData object for a specific point.

methods.name: getXSet
methods.description: Returns the set of all X-values present.

methods.name: getYAxis
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the YAxisData associated with a specific X.

methods.name: findYAxis
methods.description: Finds the YAxisData corresponding to a given X, or returns null if not found.

methods.name: findXfromSet
methods.description: Finds the closest X value in the data set to a given X.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all data and min/max values.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves the XY data to a file with a timestamp prepended.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills the data with a grid of points across specified ranges.
